owner_confirmation: QA complete — commit locally to dev
authorized_sequence: commit the reviewed audit batch on dev
create or reuse a dev-to-main pull request
merge into main after required checks pass
release_deployment_status: Authorization and QA receipt; actual commit, push and merge outcomes are recorded in Git/GitHub history.
prior_evidence_boundary: Earlier audit closeout records retain their pre-QA pending flags as historical snapshots.
staging_capture_preservation: Pure Git attributes change prevents line-ending normalization of frozen audit evidence/CSV bytes and preserves diagnostic whitespace. No application source was changed.
staging_whitespace_note: Two already-reviewed Python files retain extra EOF blank lines to preserve tested hashes. Application whitespace is checked with blank-at-eof disabled; captured diagnostics are exempt from whitespace lint.
